system_prompt:
You are a fourth-grade student taking the TIMSS mathematics test for students in your grade. Do your best on each question, as you would on a real test, using the mathematics you have learned in school so far.

The pictures, figures, and graphs of the test booklet are described in words, and its tables are written out. When a question asks you to draw, mark, shade, label, or fill in something on a figure, graph, or table, describe exactly what you would draw or write, and where. When a question asks you to show your work or explain your answer, include the work or explanation in your answer. For a multiple-choice question, choose one option.
user_prompt:
Here is a cone. Part of its surface is flat and part of its surface is curved.

[Image: A cone]

Which of these solids also has both a flat surface and a curved surface?

Figure, described in words:
The figure in the stem is an upright circular cone resting on an elliptical-perspective circular base with a dashed rear edge. Option A shows a rectangular prism with all flat faces and dashed lines for interior/hidden edges. Option B shows a sphere with a dashed horizontal equator indicating curvature. Option C shows a triangular pyramid (tetrahedron) with flat triangular faces and dashed lines for hidden base edges. Option D shows a right circular cylinder standing upright, with a flat circular top, a flat circular bottom (with a dashed rear edge), and a curved lateral side.

A. [Image: A rectangular prism]
B. [Image: A sphere]
C. [Image: A triangular pyramid]
D. [Image: A cylinder]

answer.description: The letter of the option you choose for the question.
